correctness.rationale: Every face is enumerated as a subset of a known open neighborhood; for n=6 and n=7 the complete directed Hasse graph of the described toggle matchings is topologically sorted without cycles (8,620/41,940 and 136,220/839,580 cells/covers). Exact integer unit-pivot cancellation of 798 and 3,848 pairs yields one-row Morse degree-three boundaries with nonzero coefficient multisets {+2:31,-2:23} and {+2:125,-2:131,-4:1}, each gcd=2. The simply connected Morse CW complexes thereby split as degree-two Moore spaces plus 141 and 771 three-spheres. n=5 separate acyclicity checked and n=4 is the boundary of a simplex.

value.rationale: The Johnson three-subset sequence is canonical, and the exact first n at which integral neighborhood homology acquires torsion is a natural threshold. Identifying a degree-two Moore-space summand is strictly stronger than numerical Betti data and explains the obstruction in an exact integral attaching map. The result is finite but fully motivated, establishes two subsequent cases without extrapolating, and has a reusable standalone exact proof checker.
